configurePresets.name: windows
configurePresets.description: The build: compile every obj from the sources and the committed glue (data/fullexe/plain) and link MapleStory2.exe. Reads no original exe. Resources: the stand-in, or set MS2_RESOURCES_RES to a .res taken from the exe.

configurePresets.name: linux
configurePresets.displayName: MapleStory2 client (Linux, MSVC 14.16 under Wine, Ninja)
configurePresets.description: The same build as the windows preset, with the msvc-wine toolchain in MS2_MSVC_ROOT/msvc. Reads no original exe.

configurePresets.name: fullexe
configurePresets.displayName: Maintainer: exe-reading build (needs the original exe)
configurePresets.description: cmake/fullexe: builds from this checkout and checks the objs against the original exe (MS2_EXE). For maintainers; the test lanes run this one.
